Custom Python 3 MP3 Compiler — Pipeline Visualization

demo_input.flac → demo_output.mp3
44100 Hz • 2 ch 192 kbps CBR 78 MP3 frames 7.2x compression Avg SNR: 70.2 dB

Step 1: Native FLAC Decoding to PCM

Pure Python decoder read demo_input.flac (123.5 KB), unpacked Rice-coded residuals and LPC/FIXED linear predictors, and reconstructed 88,200 samples (2 ch, 16-bit @ 44100 Hz).

Step 2: 32-Band Polyphase Analysis Filterbank

Each granule (576 samples) is passed through a 512-tap prototype FIR window (ISO 11172-3 Table 3-C.1) and 64->32 cosine modulation, splitting the signal into 32 uniform frequency subbands over 18 time slots.

Step 3: MDCT & Forward Aliasing Reduction

Odd-indexed subbands undergo time-slot sign inversion before 18 previous + 18 current subband slots are multiplied by a 36-point sine window and transformed via MDCT into 576 spectral lines (32 x 18). Adjacent-band aliasing is then cancelled via 8 orthogonal butterfly rotations.

Step 4: Psychoacoustic Model (Masking & ATH)

A 1024-point Hann-windowed FFT and Schroeder Bark-scale spreading compute which frequencies are masked by nearby louder tones or fall below the Absolute Threshold of Hearing (ATH). Quantization noise below the pink curve is inaudible.

Step 5: Non-Linear Quantization & Rate-Distortion Loop

Spectral lines are compressed via power-law companding |xr|^(3/4). The inner loop binary-searches global_gain (converging at 137), while the outer loop boosts band scalefactors whenever quantization distortion exceeds the masking threshold.

Step 6: Huffman Entropy Coding & Bit Reservoir

The 576 quantized integers are partitioned into big_values (3 regions using optimal ISO Huffman tables), count1 (-1/0/+1 quadruples), and rzero (free zero tail). The bit reservoir (main_data_begin up to 511 bytes) smooths bit demand across frames.

Step 7: Compression & Audio Quality Summary

Compiled MP3: demo_output.mp3 (47.8 KB, 78 frames @ 192 kbps). Compression ratio vs. raw PCM: 7.2x, average spectral SNR: 70.2 dB.
